title: Does debate actually help judges find truth without information asymmetry? A follow-up to the 2024 debate results

original_idea.body:
# Debate Without Information Asymmetry

Vary judge information (full/partial/none); measure debate vs single-answer accuracy.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: maps the boundary of when debate-as-oversight helps, a decision-relevant scalable-oversight question.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Lightweight debate harness on open models, vary asymmetry; clear methodology.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: open models, inference-only, outsider replication valuable.

novelty.reasoning: 2024 debate results exist; the no-asymmetry boundary mapping is flagged as open, partially addressed.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Debate experiments exist; the asymmetry-boundary mapping may be open.
